newsitem.title: USA: LCI International enters marketing pact.
newsitem.headline: LCI International enters marketing pact.

text.p: LCI International has signed a joint marketing agreement with the American Trucking Associations, the national trade association of the trucking industry.

Under the terms of the agreement, ATA's more than 35,000 member companies will have the opportunity to sign-up for LCI's new Simply Guaranteed PLUS program for commercial customers, LCI said in a statement on Tuesday.

LCI executives also said that it has signed a separate agreement to be the exclusive provider of telecommunications services to the American Trucking Association's national headquarters and legislative offices located in the Washington, D.C. area.
The cost for each of these services will be based on the member company's total volume for all of their telecommunications usage on a monthly basis, LCI said.
